nombre: configuracion electronica con la pasita acomodadora

hobby.detalle: la Pasita, jefa de staff en un concierto de K-pop que acomoda a los fans en anillos alrededor de un escenario redondo

arte.universo: An original K-pop concert night inside a huge round indoor arena, painted in the approved soft-3D anime style: a round glowing stage in the exact center, and around it concentric rings of seating zones marked on the floor by glowing sky-blue light lines; the closest ring is tiny, the next rings are bigger. Laser beams, stage smoke, confetti, LED light bokeh, dark purple and deep indigo atmosphere with a sky-blue accent light. Fans are simple round generic characters (not the Pasita, not existing people) each holding a plain round glowing lightstick with no logos. Any performers on stage are only tiny distant glowing silhouettes, never recognizable people. The Pasita is the head of the concert staff: black staff bomber jacket, a headset microphone, a sky-blue lanyard with a blank badge, a glowing sky-blue usher light wand in one hand, white gloves, sneakers, and a small PASAS raisin-in-a-circle emblem on her jacket. No text, digits, letters, logos, band names, banners with writing or franchise symbols anywhere in the image.

post:
Llegan 9 fans al concierto y la regla es llenar primero lo más cercano al escenario. ¿Dónde queda cada uno? 🎤

Si lo acomodaste, ya escribiste una configuración electrónica: 1s² 2s² 2p⁵. Así se explica en PASAS: cada tema con lo que te gusta (K-pop, anime, videojuegos o fútbol).

La última lámina es tu acordeón: guárdalo para tu examen de química.
